'''Dream''' can refer to the following:

==Books and chapters==
* ''[[Knife of Dreams]]'' - the eleventh book of ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series.
* ''[[Remembrance of Dreams]]'' - the forty-second chapter of ''[[The Eye of the World]]''.
* ''[[Wolf Dreams]]'' - the ninth chapter of ''[[The Dragon Reborn]]''.
* ''[[A World of Dreams]]'' - the twenty-first chapter of ''The Dragon Reborn''.
* ''[[What Can Be Learned in Dreams]]'' - the fifteenth chapter of ''[[The Fires of Heaven]]''.
* ''[[Dreams of Galad]]'' - the twenty-fifth chapter of ''The Fires of Heaven''.
* ''[[Dreams and Nightmares]]'' - the fourteenth chapter of ''[[Lord of Chaos]]''.
* ''[[The Scent of a Dream]]'' - the sixth chapter of ''[[Crossroads of Twilight]]''.
* ''[[Men Dream Here]]'' - the thirtieth chapter of ''[[Towers of Midnight]]''.

==Talents==
* [[Dreaming]] - a [[Talent]] that is used to [[Foretelling|foretell]] the future.
* [[Dreamwalking]] - the natural ability to enter ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' while asleep.
* [[Egwene's dreams]] - a list of [[Egwene al'Vere]]'s prophetic dreams.
* [[Perrin's Wolf Dreams]] - a list of [[Perrin Aybara]]'s prophetic dreams.

==Other==
* [[Wolf Dream]] - another name for ''Tel'aran'rhiod''.
* World of Dreams - yet another name for ''Tel'aran'rhiod''.
* ''[[Life is a Dream]]'' - a dirge for the dead among the [[Aiel]].
* [[Contagious dreams]] - a phenomenon where people dream of powerful channelers in the area
